statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i and every j with 0 <= i < len(s) and 0 <= j < len(s), if s[i] = 97 ('a') and s[j] = 98 ('b'), then i < j. Equivalently, r = false if and only if there exist i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(s), s[i] = 98 ('b'), and s[j] = 97 ('a').
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: For every s satisfying the preconditions, check_string(s) returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow. The returned r is always a Boolean value.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(s), s[i] <= s[j] as numeric byte values. Since the only allowed bytes are 97 ('a') and 98 ('b'), this says s is nondecreasing.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(s) - 1, it is not the case that s[i] = 98 ('b') and s[i+1] = 97 ('a').
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer k with 0 <= k <= len(s) such that (for every i with 0 <= i < k, s[i] = 97 ('a')) and (for every i with k <= i < len(s), s[i] = 98 ('b')).
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if lastA < firstB, where lastA is the largest index i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 97 ('a'), or lastA = -1 if there is no such index; and firstB is the smallest index i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 98 ('b'), or firstB = len(s) if there is no such index.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 97 ('a'), every j with 0 <= j < i satisfies s[j] = 97 ('a').
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').

statement: Whenever check_string(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 98 ('b'), every j with i < j < len(s) satisfies s[j] = 98 ('b').
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 97 ('a') or s[i] = 98 ('b').
